entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or order status, press three.
Agent. Just get me an agent.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you?
I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Order number is VF-9218-B450.
Certainly, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I have it here. To make sure I handle this correctly, is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the band?
It's not what I wanted. I just need to start the return process. Is it approved or not?
I understand completely. Just need to check the delivery date against our return window. I see it was delivered 15 days ago.
Right. So can I return it?

Yes, absolutely. For some of our newer devices that have direct skin contact, strict rules regarding `hygiene` and `sanitation` mean that 15 days would be `too late`. However, the current `policy` for the standard VeloBand is 90 days, so you're well within the timeframe. I've gone ahead and approved that return for you.

I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Also, I see here you're a VIP member with VeloFit, so I've waived any return fees and added a $20 credit to your account for any future purchase, just as a thank you for your loyalty.
A credit? Okay, that's fine. I'll look for the email with the label.
Perfect. Once our warehouse receives the item, your full refund will be issued back to your original payment method. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
